summary: - **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#489](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/489)** — Removes the deprecated `inputReader` Python module. It depended on `PodioInput`, which is no longer in k4FWCore, so it would not work with the upcoming release anyway. Users should migrate to `k4MarlinWrapper.io_helpers`.

- **[hep-fcc/root2gltf#16](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/16)** — Converts the geometry depth from a config property to a command-line argument so full-depth conversions are possible, and renames the remaining config properties. Existing config files need updating to the new schema; updated configs are provided for ALLEGRO, CLD, IDEA and ILD_FCCee.

- **[key4hep/DDML#19](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/19)** — Adds a `ddml` Python module providing `ddml_physics` and `add_shower_model`, plus pre-configured setups for the bundled models. It replaces the sprawling flag-driven `ddsim_steer.py` logic, and adding a new ML fast-sim model now only requires writing a `ModelConfig`.

- **[hep-fcc/fcc-drs#106](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-drs/pull/106)** — Adds a Detector(s) field to dataset requests, accepting comma-separated values such as IDEA, ALLEGRO, ALFA. The field is required whenever the Final Processing Stage is anything other than generation, is enforced on both client and server, and appears in notification emails.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#162](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/162)** — The Delphes-to-EDM4hep converter now assigns the pion mass to all tracks that are not electrons or muons, keeping energy, mass and momentum consistent, including for jets and their constituents. It also sets the PDG ID on tracks and leptons, so analysts no longer need to infer particle type from the mass. This changes converter output slightly.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#101](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/101)** — Fixes several problems in the GENFIT track fitter: incorrect units in the helix-to-Cartesian Jacobian and in the z0 conversion; a singular initial covariance in z0 when the seed is close to the reference point; broken hit–track associations introduced at the filtering stage. Track states now use GENFIT native extrapolation, with the first and last digitized hits as reference points for AtFirstHit and AtLastHit.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#70](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/70)** — Adds `TrackerHit3D` conversion to the Gaudi KalTest track-fitting machinery so it behaves the same as the Marlin version, fixing a k4GaudiPandora reconstruction issue. FTD composite space-point hits are not yet handled.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#383](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/383)** — Adds a reconstruction configuration and a sim→digi→reco CTest for IDEA option 2 (`IDEA_o2_v01`), based on the reduced geometry. It follows the latest IDEA_o1 tracking and validation updates and depends on k4RecCalorimeter#271.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#400](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/400)** — Adds an EvtGen decay card for Λb⁰ → Λ(1520)⁰ νν̄, with Λ(1520)⁰ → pK⁻ and the charge-conjugate chain, for FCC-ee flavour studies.

- **[key4hep/DDML#16](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/16)** — Initializes ML inference models before the event loop instead of lazily, and initializes the geometry late enough for DD4hep settings to take effect. Showers now default to non-hadronic.
